# Components

69 exported components, structs, enums and globals, in 16 groups.

Every component the Slint library exports, with its public properties and callbacks, taken from the sources. Import any of them from `malva.slint`:

```slint
import { Button, ButtonKind, TextField, Toggle, Theme } from "@malva/malva.slint";
```

`in` properties are set by you, `out` properties are read, `in-out` properties do both (use `<=>` to bind one to your own). Colours, sizes and timings of every component are the kit's tokens, so none of them is a property here; restyle by changing `tokens/malva-tokens.json`, not a component.

The `force` property that most interactive components have (`ForceState`: `none`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`) draws a state without the pointer, for specimens and screenshots.

## Foundations

Parts every control is made of: the focus ring, the preview switch, shared enums and the shadow helper.

### `ControlSize` — enum

Sizes shared by buttons, icon buttons, fields and segmented controls: 32, 40 and 48 px.

Values: `small`, `medium`, `large`

### `Tone` — enum

The semantic colours of status: badges, toasts and banners use them. `accent` is the brand's own plum.

Values: `neutral`, `accent`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`, `info`

### `ForceState` — enum

Lets a design sheet draw a control in a state the pointer is not producing. Real code leaves it at `none`.

Values: `none`, `hover`, `pressed`, `focus`

### `FocusRing`

The ring that shows keyboard focus: 2 px wide, 2 px outside the control. Put it last in a control that does not clip, and give it the control's radius.

| Property | | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `active` | in | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `radius` | in | `length` | `Radius.s` |  |
| `host-width` | in | `length` |  | The size of the control it rings. |
| `host-height` | in | `length` |  |  |

### `Sizing` — global

The height of a control of a given size.

Functions: `control(s: ControlSize)` → `length`

## Layout

Layout helpers with the kit's spacing: VStack and HStack (a layout with a 16 px gap), Spacer (a fixed gap) and Fill (takes the rest of the room).

### `VStack`

Inherits `VerticalLayout`; every property of `VerticalLayout` applies. Children go inside it.

### `HStack`

Inherits `HorizontalLayout`; every property of `HorizontalLayout` applies. Children go inside it.

### `Spacer`

A gap of `size` in both directions, so it works in either kind of layout.

| Property | | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `size` | in | `length` | `Space.m` |  |

### `Fill`

Stretches to take whatever room the siblings leave.

Inherits `Rectangle`; every property of `Rectangle` applies. Children go inside it.

### `Card`

A horizontal hairline: as wide as its parent (or its place in a layout), 1 px tall.

Inherits `Rectangle`; every property of `Rectangle` applies. Children go inside it.

A vertical hairline, 1 px wide.

Inherits `Rectangle`; every property of `Rectangle` applies. Children go inside it.

A flat region of the window in one of the three layers: 0 = bg, 1 = panel, 2 = surface.

A translucent plate for a bar or dock over a wallpaper. (Slint cannot blur what is behind a plate; for frosted glass draw a blurred copy of the wallpaper under it, as the menu bar does.)

Inherits `Rectangle`; every property of `Rectangle` applies. Children go inside it.

## Dialog

A modal dialog over a scrim: icon, title, message, optional content, two buttons. Escape dismisses, Enter takes the primary action. Place it last in the window so it covers everything, and give it the window's size.

The card of a dialog on its own, for dialogs that are not modal (a sheet in a window) or for design sheets.

### `Dialog`

A modal dialog over a scrim. Escape dismisses, Enter takes the primary action. Place it last in the window, as large as the window, so it covers everything. Children go between the message and the buttons.

| `below` | in | `bool` | `false` |  |

### `TipBubble`

Put this as the last child of a control, pass it the control's size and `hovered: area.has-hover`, and the control gets a tooltip after the pointer has rested on it for `delay-ms`.

| Property | | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | in | `string` |  |  |
| `hovered` | in | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `host-width` | in | `length` |  |  |
| `host-height` | in | `length` |  |  |
| `delay-ms` | in | `int` | `600` |  |
| `below` | in | `bool` | `false` |  |
| `showing` | out | `bool` |  | Whether the bubble is up (for tests and for controls that want to react). |

## Windows

Window chrome: TitleBar, WindowFrame, Sidebar and SidebarSection.

### `TitleBar`

A title bar, 44 px, with the three window controls at the left and the title in the middle. `@children` land at the right edge (toolbar buttons).

| Property | | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | in | `string` |  |  |
| `active` | in | `bool` | `true` |  |
| `show-controls` | in | `bool` | `true` |  |

Callbacks: `close()`, `minimize()`, `maximize()`

### `WindowFrame`

A window: rounded, hairline, shadow, a title bar over a content area (the children).

| Property | | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | in | `string` |  |  |
| `active` | in | `bool` | `true` |  |

Callbacks: `close()`, `minimize()`, `maximize()`

### `Sidebar`

The column of places at the left of a window. Children are SidebarItem and SidebarSection.

Inherits `Rectangle`; every property of `Rectangle` applies. Children go inside it.

### `SidebarSection`

A small heading over a group of sidebar items.

| Property | | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | in | `string` |  |  |
